source_caveats: G001-G080 and G087-G090 are exact SVGs extracted from v0.13.
G111-G130 traced from user-provided screenshots, not the lost original vector paths.
G131/G132 tentatively associated with an unlabeled screenshot, requiring user confirmation.
G081-G086 and G091-G100 are exact original v0.14 Revision 1 SVGs, not proof that their later revisions were identical or formally approved.
Authentic v0.14 R1 gesture-guide markup is preserved for the 16 newly recovered candidates; other generated guide files are NOT authentic gesture order.
G001-G080 and G087-G090 were unchanged between v0.13 and v0.14 R1, per uploaded original pack.
G101/G102 were user-approved on 2026-10-20 as two curves with common start point; G107/G108 were approved as a curl-and-sweep pair. These are modern vectors, not recovered v0.19 art.
G105/G106 upside-down G091/G092 proposal was explicitly approved 2026-10-20; earlier top-leaf draft rejected for similarity and side-leaf alternate left unapproved, both retained under drafts.
Only G001-G080, G087-G090 and G081-G086/G091-G100 have confirmed early SVG provenance. Later screenshot traces and modern approved glyph vectors do not prove lossless recovery of the missing v0.19.

2026-10-20: G147/G148 final forked-sweep pair approved and assigned; 150 contiguous active signs. Earlier G149 single was renumbered G146; approved provisional G151/G152 double spirals became G149/G150. Retired/rejected art archived; authentic lost v0.19 vectors are not fully recovered.
G101-G110 and G133-G150 are still description-based approximations (G137/G138 visually accepted previously but not geometrically exact).
